slides.name: hook
slides.head:
सबका काम संभाला।
किसी ने देखा?
slides.sub: Your effort deserves to be seen.

slides.name: wreath
slides.label: LOOK CLOSER
slides.head:
A wreath on the raised wand.
A laurel on his head.
slides.sub:
Recognition begins when you
name your own work first.

slides.name: message
slides.quote: जो मेहनत चुपचाप करती हो, उसे आवाज़ देना भी ज़रूरी है।
slides.trans: The work you do quietly deserves a voice too.
